title: Flags Born From Symbols and Struggles

sets.relationshipLabel: historical revolution that produced this national flag
sets.explanation: Each flag was born directly out of the revolution that created the nation it represents.

sets.relationshipLabel: independence movement that produced this national flag
sets.explanation: Both flags mark the moment a nation threw off old rule and adopted a new banner to match.

sets.relationshipLabel: legendary or celestial symbol adopted onto this national flag
sets.explanation: A saint's legend and a constellation each became the defining emblem stitched into a nation's flag.

sets.relationshipLabel: national symbol incorporated into this country's flag
sets.explanation: An old cultural or religious emblem was folded directly into the country's official flag design.
